testcase.name: Scenario: Set visibility of two ribbon panels independently: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/pinned-checkout/features/application/ribbon-panel-visibility/ribbon-panel-visibility.feature:126:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Set visibility of two ribbon panels independently ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the full Tools ribbon is visible ✔ And the Find and Tutorials panels are both visible ✔ When the user opens Show Panels from the Options panel title context menu ✔ And the user selects Find ✔ Then the Find panel disappears from the ribbon ✔ And Tutorials remains visible ✔ And Find is unchecked while Tutorials remains checked ✔ When the user opens Show Panels again ✔ And the user selects Find ✔ Then the Find panel reappears before Team Web ✔ And Tutorials remains visible ✔ And Find and Tutorials are both checked
